name: Avail
description: Avail is landlord and rental property management software for independent landlords and small portfolios. Landlords use it for rental listings, applications, TransUnion-powered tenant screening, lawyer-reviewed leases, online rent collection, maintenance tracking, accounting, tenant messaging, tenant portals, and rent-price analysis.
agentUseSummary: Avail cannot yet be connected through Relay as a direct self-service provider. Avail publishes product, support, terms, and privacy materials for signed-in landlord and tenant workflows, but no public developer API, OAuth app registration, endpoint schema, scopes, webhooks, sandbox, revocation, or third-party automation contract that Relay can implement.

blocked.label: Connect Avail
blocked.description: Avail does not publish a self-service developer API, OAuth app flow, API-key flow, endpoint schema, scopes, sandbox, webhooks, rate limits, revocation, tenant binding, or third-party automation terms for Relay.

blocked.label: Read Avail records
blocked.description: Properties, listings, leads, applications, screening reports, tenants, leases, rent charges, payments, deposits, fees, maintenance tickets, accounting records, messages, documents, reports, and account settings remain unavailable to Relay.

blocked.label: Change Avail records
blocked.description: Creating, updating, posting, charging, paying, collecting, reconciling, screening, messaging, listing, leasing, signing, archiving, deleting, or otherwise changing Avail records is blocked.

blocked.label: Operate payments, screening, or leases
blocked.description: Rent collection, ACH/card payments, deposits, late fees, FastPay, tenant screening, credit/background/eviction reports, applications, lease generation, e-signature, and legal document workflows are blocked.

blocked.label: Use private Avail access
blocked.description: Browser automation, session cookies, user passwords, private APIs, traffic inspection, screen scraping, unofficial endpoints, and provider-console activity are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Avail action is enabled until Avail and Relay approve a bounded integration contract covering credential ownership, landlord and tenant authorization, data categories, screening and payment constraints, legal and fair-housing obligations, limits, audit, retention, revocation, and disconnect behavior.

runtimeSupport.description: No Avail tools are mounted without an official developer contract, approved credentials, and typed property-management operations.
No Avail tools are mounted without an official developer contract, approved credentials, and typed property-management operations.

providerSetup.blocker: Avail's official product, support, terms, and privacy materials describe a signed-in landlord and tenant property-management service with rental listings, applications, tenant screening, credit/background/eviction reports, lease documents, e-signature, rent collection, ACH/card payments, maintenance, accounting, messages, reports, and tenant portals. Those materials do not publish a self-service developer API, OAuth app registration, API key issuance, endpoint schema, scopes, sandbox, webhooks, rate limits, revocation, user and property binding, screening authorization, payment authority, lease-signing authority, or third-party automation terms for Relay.
providerSetup.nextAction: Product, partnerships, legal, privacy, security, housing-compliance, payments, screening, leasing, and property-management owners must obtain Avail's current partner/developer integration terms, if any. Before implementation, freeze the credential model, landlord and tenant consent, readable fields, write authority, screening and payment exclusions, legal-document boundaries, communications rules, fair-housing and TCPA constraints, audit, retention, redaction, revocation, deletion, and disconnect behavior, then complete live acceptance in the provider-console task.

evidence.supports: Avail identifies itself as all-in-one landlord and property-management software for listing rentals, screening tenants, signing leases, collecting rent, tracking maintenance, accounting, tenant messaging, and tenant portals.

Avail's feature page describes one-click listings, comprehensive rental applications, TransUnion screening reports, lawyer-reviewed leases, secure online rent collection, maintenance tracking, accounting, and centralized tenant conversations.

Avail support materials organize landlord workflows for applications, tenant screening, rent collection, listings, maintenance tracking, account settings, and other signed-in product operations, not public API integration.

Avail's terms define Managers, Tenants, Services, account obligations, tenant application information, background-check handling, privacy duties, communications consent obligations, and restrictions on unauthorized use.
Avail's privacy policy covers personal information processed through the Website and Services, including account and service data.
Avail's community rules emphasize responsible, honest, inclusive landlord and tenant conduct, including privacy and data privacy expectations.
